objective: Count how many of the five specified products have at least 2 items available today at the central Ljubljana hardware branch.

params.store_id: lookup from stores WHERE city = 'Ljubljana' AND store_name LIKE '%central%hardware%branch%'
params.product_skus: for each of the five product descriptions, find product_sku by joining product_variants and product_variant_properties where brand, series (or product_family_name), and property_key/property_value_text match the description: 1) brand='Heco', series='Heco Zinc Plated TopFix GTU-YPJ Wood and Drywall Screw', property_key='screw_type', property_value_text='drywall screw'; 2) brand='Festool', series='Festool Stackable SYS 3JJ-9LM Tool Box and Bag', property_key='storage_type', property_value_text='tool bag'; 3) same brand/series, property_key='storage_type', property_value_text='parts case'; 4) brand='Ajax', series='Ajax Eco Classic 25C-DXE Cleaning Liquid', property_key='cleaner_type', property_value_text='floor cleaner'; 5) same brand/series, property_key='cleaner_type', property_value_text='degreaser'
